referencePolicy.sourcePriority: Current official DallasCowboys.com roster/player headshot pages
referencePolicy.visualRule: Inspect the cited current official headshot before rendering. Never infer complexion, hair, facial hair, or facial features from a player's name.
referencePolicy.style: realistic 3D chibi; adult football proportions; recognizable at Gamecast scale

render.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim

players.name: Malachi Lawrence
renderNotes: Use the current official Dallas headshot as sole visual authority for complexion and visible face/hair details.
Edge/OLB build: tall, explosive pass-rush frame; preserve #57.
Prioritize stance, edge rush, pursuit, tackle, sack, forced fumble, recovery, pass breakup and teammate celebration; no invented named celebration.

players.name: Tyrus Wheat
renderNotes: Use the current official Dallas headshot as sole visual authority for complexion and visible face/hair details.
Edge/OLB build: compact, powerful pass-rush proportions; preserve current official roster #59.
Prioritize stance, edge rush, pursuit, tackle, sack, forced fumble, recovery, pass breakup and special-teams pursuit; no invented named celebration.

players.name: Tyler Guyton
renderNotes: Use the current official Dallas headshot as sole visual authority for complexion and visible face/hair details.
Tackle build: exceptionally tall, broad, athletic offensive-line proportions; preserve #60.
Prioritize stance, pass set, kick slide, run block, reach block, double-team, pancake, recovery and fumble recovery; teammate celebration only, with no invented solo signature.

notes: Current official Dallas player pages verify Malachi Lawrence #57 (6-4, 253), Tyrus Wheat #59 (6-2, 260), and Tyler Guyton #60 (6-7, 325).
Official Dallas player pages expose current headshot image labels for all three; renderers must visually inspect those headshots rather than infer appearance traits.
Tyrus Wheat's current summary page is authoritative for #59; an older/stale splits page may still display his prior #90, so production must use #59.
No player-specific named celebration was added because no repeatable signature was verified for this batch.
